transcript: The work I'm most proud of is our monthly newsletter. When I joined my last company the newsletter was, um, quite boring, it was basically a list of product updates and nobody really opened it. The open rate was around twelve percent. I asked my manager if I could take it over and she said yes. I changed the format, I added a short story from a customer each month, some tips on how to use the product, and I made the subject lines more interesting, more like questions. I also cleaned the mailing list because there were a lot of old emails bouncing. After about four months the open rate was around twenty-five percent. I was really happy about that. Some customers even replied to say they liked the stories. My part was really the whole thing, writing, design with the designer's templates, and sending it. I didn't really track if it led to more sales, that was harder to measure, and to be honest I wasn't sure how. But it helped the brand, I'm fairly sure. I'd like to do something similar here.
